propositions: module_size_trend and cap_change_events metrics are advertised in docs but not registered in git_metrics.py registry

module_size_trend must walk date-filtered commit history, require at least two qualified revisions with valid cap blob and tracked Python modules, and return deterministically ordered samples with SHA, timestamp, cap, module count, and maximum LOC

cap_change_events must compare adjacent qualified revisions before sampling and return ordered change events with from/to cap values, SHA, and timestamp; a qualifying history with no changes returns an empty list not Unavailable

both metrics must sample at most 50 evenly spaced revisions (including endpoints) when history exceeds 50, report total qualified-revision count, and return structured Unavailable with specific reason for fewer than two qualified revisions or Git/cap/module errors
existing CLI and metrics schema accept registered metrics without per-ID code changes; implementation adds real computation specs with code_health/git/high provenance
test suite must replace cap-change deregistration assertion with live metric coverage and retain commit_cadence_trend in freed-ID guards
